picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals the federal government's flagship push to embed AI directly into national scientific infrastructure, from particle-collider data streams to broader discovery pipelines.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's Jason Zhang using generative AI to design proteins never seen in nature, building on Nobel laureate David Baker's techniques, represents a genuine scientific breakthrough with implications for medicine and biomaterials.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial proteomics could meaningfully improve cancer treatment prediction across tumor types, a rare case of AI directly advancing precision oncology.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub led by Cambridge to fuse stem-cell tissue models with AI-driven drug development is a substantial bet on accelerating how new medicines reach patients.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: RoboDojo, built by HKU with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes the first unified benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability — the kind of shared infrastructure that accelerates an entire research field.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's Genesis Mission funding to apply AI toward quantum computing error correction targets one of the hardest open problems standing between today's quantum hardware and practical use.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's Genesis Mission partnership with Fermilab to build AI tools for sifting high-energy physics data shows the initiative's reach into fundamental physics, not just applied engineering.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: A $12 million Army Research Laboratory grant to Penn State for animal-inspired sensing in autonomous drones and robots is a significant defense investment in next-generation AI perception systems.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: SRI's ARPA-H-backed PARADIGM system, developed with Mayo Clinic and the University of Florida to guide healthcare workers through procedures like blood draws and intubation, pairs AI with real clinical stakes.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: A DOE-funded University of Arkansas project to defend the AI systems managing the electric grid addresses critical-infrastructure security as AI becomes embedded in national energy operations.
picks.title: DOE Funds U of A Research to Safeguard the AI Behind America's Electric Grid
